cases_full.question: What are the 5 most expensive products?

    SELECT p.ProductKey, p.EnglishProductName, p.ListPrice,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ProductKey ORDER BY p.ListPrice DESC) AS rn,
           MAX(p.ListPrice) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ProductKey) AS max_list_price
    FROM FactInternetSales f
    JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
)
SELECT ProductKey, EnglishProductName, max_list_price
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5;
